svg.text: Co-issue is a 1:4 LUXURY: at 1:2 a 2-phase cmd fills both slots (no filler); at 1:1 it straddles 2 bundles. One object per bundle at 1:2 / 1:1.

text.font-family: Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: DQ rule: RD / WR / MRR share ONE burst -> <=1 DQ-op per bundle; MRR blocks a CAS.

text.font-family: Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Rank-exclusive (REFab, PREab, MRW, MRR, ZQ, RFMab, SR/PD) = SOLO bundle at every gear -> gate whole rank.

text.font-family: Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Same-bank-scope (REFsb, PREsb, RFMsb) co-issue a CAS only at 1:4; at 1:2/1:1 they still spare the rank across adjacent bundles (stage 9).

text.font-family: Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Filler/co-issue exists only at 1:4 (4 slots); 1:2 fits one 2-phase object, 1:1 streams one phase/clk with 2-cyc cmds straddling. Rank-exclusive maintenance is solo at every gear.
